$Comment: What Bram's extra roll in a Christmas Present holds (Christmas_Bram_Present.json): one draw from the bag
below, weighted against each other, one of the game's own Christmas decorations to put up at home, the
snowflake tree topper (WinterHoliday_Snowflake) now and then. Every item goes where the opening player's
pickup settings send it, and whatever their bag cannot take drops at their feet. Text names it on the
notice; its words are in christmas.mmo.lang.
Name: Christmas_Bram_Decorations
